newsitem.title: USA: Lee Enterprises names new broadcast heads.
newsitem.headline: Lee Enterprises names new broadcast heads.

text.p: Lee Enterprises Inc on Monday named a new station manager for its television station in Honolulu and its station in El Paso, Texas.

Ray Depa, the station manager for KZIA-TV in El Paso, will become station manager for KGMB-TV in Honolulu, the company said. Dan Kempner, general sales manager for KZIA, will assume the additional responsibility of station manager.

Lee Enterprises owns and operates nine full-service network affiliated television stations, seven satellite television stations, publishes 19 daily newspapers and 40 weekly and specialty publications.
